newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-E.P. IN CONTROL AT 401-4 AGAINST GRIQUAS.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-E.P. IN CONTROL AT 401-4 AGAINST GRIQUAS.

text.p: Louis Koen smashed a brilliant 186 to propell Eastern Province to a massive 401 for four at the close of the first day of their four-day match against Griqualand West at St George's Park on Friday.
On a good batting pitch the E.P. batsmen capitalised on Kepler Wessels' winning of the toss to harvest five bonus batting points while limiting Griquas to just one for bowling.
The day started promisingly for the visitors when they reduced E.P. to 38 for the loss of Philip Amm in the first hour.
But the arrival of Koen swiftly transformed the situation, and in partnerships of 153 with Mark Rushmere (63) and 124 with Kepler Wesels (40), he helped E.P. take complete control.
Hitting the ball with immense power, Koen smashed four sixes and 25 fours in his 186 which came off 229 balls.
Bowling: Walsh 25-2-95-2, Roe 27-4-70-0, English 20-1-111-2, Dry 2-0-10-0, Benkenstein 14-0-65-0, Gidley 16-0-47-0.
Bonus points: Eastern Province 5, Griqualand West 1.
